semantic_findings: dataset.ini gives units but not the pressure reference type, so absolute, gauge, and differential cannot be distinguished. Treat the reference type as UNKNOWN.
The source describes offshore wells with subsea trees, gas lift, and a DHSV. Physical compatibility with an onshore gas well must be assessed before any scenario mapping.
